name: software_nextflow
description: Nextflow / nf-core pipelines (taxteller): install the launcher into a session on the login node with Java 17, keep all Nextflow state out of home, and read a pipeline checkout (main.nf, modules, test profile, samplesheet) to find a small smoke command. Load for any Nextflow, nf-core, main.nf or samplesheet.csv application.

history.why: Chat d8e7b5f4c86b (Annotate: tax-teller) met Nextflow for the first time: no capability covered it. Install recipe, Java 17 need, SSH clone host and repo layout reading were done by hand in about 10 Bash calls; the annotation approach (bash EXIT trap in process scripts) is only planned.
